deviations: survey_clean.R links survey barangays to official barangays with fastLink (not installed); replaced by an exact barangay-name match, which matches all 10 treated survey barangays (control weights are 1 regardless).

ri::estate / ri::genprobexact replaced by direct computation: assignment probability = share of assigned barangays within each city; ITT = lm(y ~ assignment + city dummies) with weights Z/p + (1-Z)/(1-p). Randomization-inference p-values and clustered SEs were not computed (only coefficients and N are claimed).
notes: Attempt 1 was exploratory (inspected data_agg and survey_raw barangay names, attendance). Final script follows tables_figures_agg.R (Table 1), survey_clean.R (Anderson-style inverse-covariance indices, standardized on treatment==0 s.d.), tables_fig_ind.R (C.3/C.4: WLS with attendance weights att.prop/attendance.agg, city FE, by party list) and tables_fig_ind_unweighted.R (F.1: assignment-probability weights, city FE). All values match the claims to the reported precision except F.1 col 2 (23.267 vs claimed 23.242); not iterated on.
